entries.title: Bring keys from a tool on another of your computers into Secrets
entries.body: When the tool that holds your keys is on another of your computers, a crewmate working there can now offer to bring them into Secrets too. The same card appears on this computer and says which computer the command runs on. When you press Bring into Secrets, that computer runs the tool and sends only the keys you ticked, once, straight into Secrets here; your crew gets names and references, never a value. Before, the move had to run on this computer.
entries.noPicture: The card is the one a bring on this computer raises, with one more line naming the computer the command runs on.
